documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V3.0: PA6-CF
Bambu PA6-CF Safety Data Sheet SDS20260701N05
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility
PET-CF / PPA-CF / PPS-CF / PA6 CF Carbon Fibers Filament Usage Guide

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values (Mechanical Properties; specimens annealed and dried at 80 °C for 12 h before testing); the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 48 ± 6 MPa, elongation 3.7 ± 0.8 %, bending modulus 2240 ± 220 MPa, bending strength 80 ± 7 MPa, impact 15.5 ± 1.7 kJ/m²) are not stored. Density, melting, glass transition, Vicat and HDT come from the TDS Physical Properties table and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 4430 ± 310 MPa, Z 2170 ± 230 MPa), melt index (6.8 ± 0.6 g/10 min at 280 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature (185 °C, DSC 10 °C/min), heat deflection temperature 186 °C at 0.45 MPa, saturated water absorption rate (2.35% at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed with desiccant), retraction length (0.8 - 1.4 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), chamber temperature (45 - 60 °C), max overhang angle (~ 70°), max bridging length (~ 40 mm), spool material (PC + ABS, temperature resistance 90 °C), spool size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), suggested annealing of prints (80 to 130 °C, 6 to 12 hours), odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products rows.
The TDS recommended chamber temperature (45 - 60 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (number, template field chamber_temp_max), not a filament print setting.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: product name "Bambu PA6-CF", model "N05-xx", CLP "Not classified", the section 8 carbon-fibre handling warning (gloves when loading/unloading, cutting or sanding), and "Not hazardous goods" for sea (IMDG), DOT, road (ADR/RID) and air (ICAO-TI / IATA) transport. Its section 8 reads "carbon fiber-reinforced filament （Glass fiber-reinforced filament)", a wording slip in the SDS. Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values.

Source disagreements kept for review: nozzle temperature (TDS 260 - 290 °C vs material-table wiki 260 - 300 for the PA-CF/GF, PA6-CF/GF, PAHT-CF/GF class); bed temperature (TDS 80 - 100 °C vs material-table plate table 100 - 120 ℃ and its glue table 90 - 110 °C for the "PA / PA-CF/GF / PAHT-CF/GF" class); AMS HT drying (carbon-fibre wiki 80 °C, 12 h vs drying wiki 85 °C, 12 h). The product TDS values are kept; no AMS HT drying value is stored (the registry has one drying temperature key, holding the TDS oven value).

Net weight: the TDS lists "Net Filament Weight 1 kg" only, while the store sells 0.5kg and 1kg. The curated row covers the 1kg value; the 0.5kg value keeps the store page's own option row (500 g, official_variant).

Printer guidance: the carbon-fibre wiki says "Requires an enclosed printer; not compatible with P1P / A1 series"; the material-table wiki recommends an enclosed printer and rates open-frame printers "Not Recommended". The carbon-fibre wiki (2.4) says PA6-CF "is more flexible than the three filaments above. When used in the H2D, there is no need to secure the left nozzle."

AMS: the store page ("All AMS Series NOT Compatible", and FAQ "Not compatible with AMS Series") and the carbon-fibre wiki ("AMS series not compatible") agree for feeding. The AMS HT is still named for drying and sealing only (carbon-fibre wiki 2.3); the AMS 2 Pro cannot dry it ("Not compatible" in the drying wiki).

Moisture: the store FAQ (3.Mechanical Properties & Moisture Impact) says strength and stiffness decrease after the filament or the prints absorb water; the carbon-fibre wiki quantifies it for flexural strength (151 MPa dry, 95 MPa humid) and flexural modulus (5460 MPa dry, 3560 MPa humid). Only the dry TDS values are stored.

Marketing prose proves no number: "Superior Strength and Stiffness", "Toughness & Vibration Resistance", "Exceptional Thermal Resistance" and the page-builder prose ("Impact & Vibration Resistance") are not stored as values. The page-builder sections also carry text comparison tables ("Superior Strength and Stiffness": bending strength XY 151 MPa, bending modulus XY 5460 MPa; "Exceptional Thermal Resistance": HDT 0.45 MPa 186 ℃; "Parameters Comparison", column "PA6-CF": impact XY 40.3 kJ/m² dry / 57.2 wet, bending strength XY 151 / 95 MPa, bending Z 80 / 45 MPa, bending modulus XY 5460 / 3560 MPa, impact Z 15.5 kJ/m² dry, HDT 0.45 MPa 186 ℃, water absorption 2.35 % at 25 °C, 55% RH).
